descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S05 「不寻常的写法在 Save Note 和重新加载之后逐字不变，两个模式」 Unusual phrasing survives Save Note and a reload word for word, both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 The stored dictation is identical on reopen: Save Note never rewrites, summarizes or renames the physician's text (issue #39), tested with unusual phrasing.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The make-session Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident

When Type the odd text into each pre-round box, Save Note, reload the page, reopen the editor

Then The box shows exactly what was typed: misspelling 'furosamide' not corrected, arrows, '??', abbreviations, the hyphenated name and the patient's words unchanged

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs: every distinctive segment present in the reopened editor (case-insensitive substring). Byte-identical (case, line breaks) needs the runnerGap check (Q9)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
